en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2790 - Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id narrated from Isma‘il ibn Hammam al-Makki, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as), from his father (as), who said:

Abu Abdullah (as) said:
"For someone obligated to walk [during the Hajj rituals], if they have thrown pebbles at the Jamrah, they may visit the Kaaba (for tawaf) while riding."
